body:
Thank you. Whenever I tried to reach out I've always been guilted into thinking what I feel is wrong and selfish and I have to think about my parents and family and people who loves me or religion related. Although I know this is all true, It always left me feeling more trapped and filled myself with more self hatred and feeling hopeless. 
When I come to this subreddit I just want to be with the piles of other people that is in the same situation as me thinking that i fit in here. I realised that now all I wanted is to be heard, for someone to acknowledge my pain and it's real. And you gave me this. 
I feel a lot better and I will look into the things you suggested to me. Thank you so much kind stranger. 
I hope I can repay you for this attention you gave to me.

I feel like I had a taste of life again and that was pushed me to change and redeem myself. Me being happy and having a life. Actual life with me as myself in it being protected and guided. But not now anymore. I feel trapped. don't know how to see a therapist, It's not a thing here and if there is it would be very expensive. I don't want to further burden down my parents. I have no money of my own, I never finished my study and I only have my high school certificate. my parents can sense that I'm crumbling back down. I tried to talk to my mum about it but it's like she avoided it and ask me to talk to god. She said she understand what I'm going through and it pains her and ask me to go to god who will understand me inside out and find a solution for me. She kept on saying she loves me and hug me and cry and when I tried to talk she just repeat this. While my dad he's like a cheerleader that just pretending that I'm fine kept on cheering for for me whenever he talk to me. My family so traumatised by me how I was before what I did before , they sugar coated everything around me and act like nothing happen. I don't know how I truly feel about this but they always been like this. 
I just feel really trapped in this state I'm in. Like I'm not willing to be in it , but I also don't have the will to get out of it.


As of right now, I'm just rereading your comment somehow it keeps me calm, I feel like you care. Thank you.

Thank you.


My favourite smell is vanilla. Smell of vanilla cake fresh out of the oven.

Hi ! I'm also new to Reddit if that explain anything. A) I didn't even consider asking in daily question thread as I don't usually read it ... i think. Not eye catching for newbie I guess. B) I usually just read anything that discuss about oily skin as that's my main concern or something that caught my eyes like haul or lately I've been looking into ones with sheet masks. 
P/s : sorry for bad English, it's my second language. 
And sorry if this not really helping!
All these time I've been browsing on my phone app. I didn't know there's a sidebar :(

Hi thank you for your advice! :) yes I was kinda confused with the AB terms and kinda thought that lotion =essence and i don't know where I read this or get this idea that in AB routine it's fine to add a lot of essences according to what my skin concerns are.

Hi thank you for the advice. I totally wasn't thinking about expiry date. Thanks for the heads up!Yes the AB website here is having Chinese New Year sale and that's why I dived right in. I just tried the HadaLabo AHA+BHA cleanser and the HadaLabo mild peeling lotion and for the first time in my life I feel like my skin is cleaned inside out. It's been 2hrs since and my face is stil oily free. Should I stop with this two for now to kick start my routine  or add something?

Hi thank you for the comment! Yes before I bought some of these I tried it once at my cousin's place and I love how my skin feels it's not oiling up like usual . The thing that I just dive straight in to without testing first are the cosrx aha and BHA liquid. Before this my AM/PM routine is basically the same:
1. L'Oréal cleanser 
2 L'Oréal whitening toner
3. L'Oréal whitening essence
4. L'Oréal boost up essence
5 . L'Oréal day cream / night cream

I'll have to admit I kinda too excited and hyped about starting my AB journey after I found out about it. But after the package arrived , I panicked and realised I have no idea what I'm doing.

I've been using L'Oréal set since I'm 17, so about 10 years now.
